2026020283.title: The streak meets the hot hand
2026020283.dek: Connor McDavid has a point in all 18 games. Dylan Garand has been the best thing about the Rangers. Something gives in Edmonton.
threads: Edmonton is living large: +21 in goals on chances worth about +5. Finishing like that rarely lasts.
New York has won three straight and earned them, with 60% of the expected goals.
Devon Levi, just off injured reserve, gets the Oilers' net.
2026020283.hunch: The books give the Rangers 41%. Our numbers say 48%, and our gut is with the numbers: New York steals one.

2026020284.title: Somebody has to win this
2026020284.dek: Two teams in free fall, each getting 41% of the chances at five on five. One skid ends tonight in Vancouver.
threads: The Canucks are winless in five, outscored 22-12, with seven points in 19 games.
The Flyers blew a lead and lost in overtime in Calgary last night. Now they play again.
Matvei Michkov has 10 points in his last 10. Brock Boeser is two points from 500.
2026020284.hunch: Our numbers lean Flyers. Our gut sees tired legs and a team that is overdue: the Canucks finally get one.

2026020285.title: Celebrini can't do it alone
2026020285.dek: He played a career-high 28:05 on Saturday. The Sharks lost anyway, their fifth in a row.
threads: San Jose has been outscored 22-8 in the skid on 40% of the chances. This is not bad luck.
The Islanders take 4.7 penalties a game. The Sharks' penalty kill has given up five goals in two games.
Ilya Sorokin and Yaroslav Askarov have both been excellent. That may be all that keeps this close.
2026020285.hunch: The most penalized team on tonight's slate visits the leakiest penalty kill. Even with two hot goalies, our gut says goals.
